scope: Old development seeds only; strict harmless-note spelling correction. No ranking or final worlds.
hypothesis: Recover otherwise feasible work rejected solely because of one or two unambiguous spelling errors in already recognized harmless clauses.

semanticsGate.required: Every unchanged revealed selected order must have no unmodeled readiness, release time, equipment, tyre, deadline or hours restriction.

implementationConstraint: Opt-in only. Existing strict parser must accept the entire corrected note. Never correct protected equipment or timing words, numbers, short words, or ambiguous candidates. Maximum two single-edit word corrections. No policy tuning against fresh late-rescue evaluation seeds.
freshValidation: Only after development gates pass; freeze exact source/settings and predeclare a new paired panel before inspecting its outcomes.
